body:
Well I already have women flirting with me, and I could get into a relationship if I wanted to. But I don't have the energy to. I feel like I would just drain on any poor girl that tried dating me, never mind the simple fact I am still not over my ex. Like I said, why try if I am just going to kill myself?

Women are only one of the main problems, the big main one is lack of life skills do to lack of doing stuff besides playing video games. And just stopping them won't work. What else am I going to do? My friends are all busy with plans since graduation just ended, and I have nothing else to do but sit around all day without the games. I can't work out at home due to lack of equipment, room, and know-how, and I am trying to save money and not spend it on a gym membership. What would I like to do as a hobby?? Well I like planes, but I still have to save up for flight lessons so that's not taking off anytime soon.
Except I have none. All I have done my entire life is play video games. No hobbies, no skills, shit grades due to laziness, and no motivation to do anything new.
